{{CharInfobox| color={{pearl color}} | corecolor={{pearl color light}} | bordercolor={{pearl color dark}} | name=Queen Rin | jname=リーン | tmname=Rin| slogan=no | image=Rin.png | size=150px | caption=Queen Rin | gender=Female | hometown=[[Rota]] | region=[[Kanto]] | relatives=[[Queen Ilene]] (descendant)| trainer=no | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=M08 | epname=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew | enva=[[Erica Schroeder|Bella Hudson]] | java=Momoko Kikuchi | }} '''Queen Rin''' (Japanese: '''リーン''' ''Rin'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. ==History== [[File:Queen Rin.png|250px|left|thumb|Queen Rin]] Rin was the Queen of [[Rota]] during the time of [[Sir Aaron]]. However, times were not peaceful while she resided over the kingdom. Two unnamed armies were about to face each other in combat. Rin refused to back down, and remained at the castle, even though the situation looked grim. Rin was unsure of what Aaron's plan to stop the fighting would be, until his {{p|Pidgeot}} returned his staff to her. When she realized that he had sacrificed himself for the kingdom, she broke down.
